# Penn State Pressbooks – Open Resource Publishing

> Penn State's Pressbooks platform for creating, publishing, and sharing open educational resources (OER) and course materials.

Penn State Pressbooks is part of the Unizin network and supports faculty and instructors in publishing accessible, openly-licensed educational content. The platform enables book authoring in multiple formats (EPUB, PDF, web) with support for interactive content via H5P and Creative Commons licensing.

## Getting Started

- [Penn State Pressbooks Homepage](https://psu.pb.unizin.org): Main entry point for Penn State's open resource publishing platform
- [PSU OER Pressbooks Quick Start Guide](https://psu.pb.unizin.org/psuoerqsg): Quick start guide for creating and publishing books on Penn State Pressbooks
- [Account Registration & Signup](https://psu.pb.unizin.org/wp-signup.php): Register a new account and sign up for Penn State Pressbooks access

- [Help & Support](https://psu.pb.unizin.org/help): Comprehensive help resources and support for Penn State Pressbooks users
